dom.من ركام الهدم إلى أساسات المستقبل…: From demolition rubble to the foundations of the future…
Building tomorrow's Oman, with no waste today.
dom.مشروع طلابي مبتكر لتحويل مخلفات الطوب وا: An innovative student project that turns brick and concrete waste into a sustainable national resource that supports the circular economy.
dom.مبادرة طلابية من مدرسة الفاروق: A student initiative from Al-Farouq School
dom.كل مبنى يُهدم يترك وراءه أطنانًا من الطو: Every demolished building leaves behind tons of brick and concrete. We turn that burden into a resource.
dom.تُكدَّس مخلفات الهدم في المكبات وتستهلك: Demolition waste piles up in landfills, consuming land and polluting soil and air.
dom.نقل المخلفات ودفنها يكلّف مبالغ كبيرة، ب: Hauling and burying waste costs a lot, while new raw materials are bought from quarries.

dom.دمج الركام المعاد تدويره مع مواد أساسية: Blending the recycled aggregate with base materials in precise engineered ratios.
New, sustainable bricks, ready to use.

dom.من فكرة بيئية إلى مشروع يبيع ويربح: المش: From an environmental idea to a project that sells and earns: the problem, the added value, and the executive summary.
dom.المقاول العُماني يدفع مرتين: مرة ليتخلص: The Omani contractor pays twice: once to get rid of demolition rubble, and again to buy new building materials.
dom.حصة مخلفات البناء والهدم، وهي أكبر مجرى: The share of construction and demolition waste, the largest waste stream in Oman
dom.ما استلمته «بيئة» من مخلفات البناء والهد: Construction and demolition waste received by Be'ah
dom.لاستقبال مخلفات البناء، وهي مصدر موادنا: for receiving construction waste, which is the source of our raw materials
dom.تكلفة نقل الركام وتفريغه، ومخاطر المخالف: The cost of hauling and dumping rubble, plus the risk of fines if it is dumped randomly in wadis.
dom.ركام ورمل وطابوق جديد من المحاجر، مع تكل: New aggregate, sand, and bricks from quarries, plus transport costs and distance.
dom.المعالجة الحالية تنتج غالبًا حصى ورمل ور: Current processing mostly yields gravel, sand, and fill, while finished, spec-compliant building products are rare. This is where Midmak comes in.
dom.لماذا سيشعر العميل بالحاجة؟ لأن منتجنا ي: Why will customers need it? Because our product cuts both bills at once and gives them proof of their environmental commitment, at a time when policies are moving toward higher landfill-diversion rates.
dom.مادة أولية شبه مجانية، وقد نتقاضى رسوم ا: Near-free raw material, and we may charge a receiving fee
dom.أخف، لأن كثافة الركام المعاد تدويره أقل: Lighter, because recycled aggregate is less dense
dom.موصلية أقل؛ وجدت دراسة أنها أقل بنحو 27%: Lower conductivity; one study found it about 27% lower in recycled concrete
dom.أعلى، ونعالجه بنسبة استبدال محسوبة ومعال: Higher, which we manage with a calculated replacement ratio and surface treatment
dom.مطابقة للمواصفة بنسب مضبوطة، ويُنصح ألا: Meets the specification at controlled ratios; crushed brick is advised not to exceed 25% of the coarse aggregate
dom.مكبات ومحاجر أقل، ونقل أقصر: Fewer landfills and quarries, shorter transport
Advisor's tip: we don't sell a promise we haven't proven. We lead with price and sustainability, and add weight and insulation once a lab certificate confirms them.
dom.مدماك شركة عُمانية ناشئة تحوّل مخلفات ال: Midmak is an Omani startup that turns demolition waste, a burden that is buried at a cost, into sustainable bricks and garden tiles, at a lower price and with a smaller environmental footprint.
dom.نربح من مصدرين: رسوم استلام الركام، وبيع: We earn from two sources: rubble receiving fees, and sales of tested, spec-compliant products to contractors, municipalities, and developers.
dom.الخطوة التالية: اختبار مخبري وعرض تجريبي: Next step: lab testing and a pilot demonstration
dom.المصادر: «بيئة» عبر Oman Observer وCircl: Sources: Be'ah via Oman Observer and Circle Economy, and studies on recycled concrete (PolyU, TU Delft, and Manipal). Performance values are estimates until lab testing.
dom.ثماني مراحل من الركام إلى بلاطة حديقة مس: Eight stages from rubble to a porous garden tile. Tap any stage to read its details.
dom.تصوّر تصميمي لبلاطة مدماك المسامية: فتحا: A design concept of the Midmak porous tile: openings filled with gravel or plants. Not an image of a manufactured prototype yet.
dom.استلام الركام من مواقع الهدم ومواقع «بيئ: Receiving rubble from demolition sites and Be'ah sites.
dom.نستلم الركام من مواقع الهدم والتجديد ومن: We receive rubble from demolition and renovation sites and from Be'ah's dedicated construction-waste sites, and record its source and quantity.
dom.فصل الركام النظيف عن الحديد والخشب والبل: Separating clean rubble from steel, wood, and plastic.
dom.نفصل الخرسانة والطوب عن الحديد والخشب وا: We separate concrete and brick from steel, wood, plastic, and soil, because impurities weaken the tile.
Crushing and screening into sizes ready for mixing.
dom.تكسّر الكسارة القطع الكبيرة، ثم نغربلها: The crusher breaks the large pieces, then we screen them into coarse and fine sizes and remove the dust.
Three mixes, A, B, and C, in different ratios.
dom.نجهّز ثلاث خلطات بنسب استبدال مختلفة للر: We prepare three mixes with different replacement ratios of recycled aggregate, to find the best balance between strength and drainage.
Openings and joints that let rainwater in.
dom.نصمم البلاطة بفتحات وفواصل تسمح بدخول ما: We design the tile with openings and joints that let rainwater in, filled with gravel or plants as in the concept above.
Casting the tiles in molds and letting them harden.
dom.نصب الخلطة أو نكبسها في قوالب، ثم نتركها: We pour or press the mix into molds, then leave it to harden in damp conditions until it gains its strength.
Measuring strength and water permeability before making any claim.
dom.نقيس مقاومة الضغط ونفاذية الماء وامتصاص: We measure compressive strength, water permeability, and shock absorption, and we announce no result until the lab confirms it.
dom.تركيب البلاط في الحديقة: Installing the tiles in the garden
Laying the tiles on a gravel bed over the soil.
dom.نفرش البلاطات على طبقة حصى فوق التربة ون: We lay the tiles on a gravel bed over the soil and fill the joints with gravel, so rain seeps into the ground instead of running across the surface (the design goal).
dom.الفكرة: إنتاج طوب معاد تدويره من مخلفات: The idea: producing recycled brick from construction waste that contains a natural or engineered additive that helps repel some insects without harming the surrounding environment. The goal is to reduce insects approaching and gathering around the brick, especially in gardens and green spaces, by releasing the repellent gradually while protecting plants and beneficial organisms.
dom.تقنية Microencapsulation تضع المادة الطا: Microencapsulation places the repellent inside tiny capsules, so it is released gradually instead of evaporating or leaking out all at once during brick manufacturing.
dom.زيت السترونيلا: نباتي الرائحة يساعد على: Citronella oil: a plant-based scent that helps repel mosquitoes and some insects. Neem oil: contains compounds with a repellent effect. Lemon and eucalyptus: an option worth testing.
dom.تُثبَّت الكبسولات في طبقة سطحية مسامية أ: The capsules are fixed in a porous surface layer or a coating compatible with the brick's composition, and the layer is designed to release the material over an extended period.
dom.كيف ندمج المادة في الطوب؟: How do we integrate the material into the brick?
Choosing a suitable material such as citronella.
dom.وضع المادة داخل كبسولات دقيقة بغلاف بولي: Placing the material inside tiny capsules with a suitable polymer shell.
dom.دمجها في طبقة سطحية مسامية أو طلاء متواف: Embedding them in a porous surface layer or a coating compatible with the brick's composition.
dom.تصميم الطبقة بحيث تتحرر المادة على مدى ز: Designing the layer so the material is released over an extended period.
dom.كيف نثبت نجاح الخاصية؟ أربع تجارب: How do we prove the feature works? Four experiments
dom.هل تبتعد الحشرات عن الطوب؟: Do insects stay away from the brick?
dom.هل تستمر الخاصية بعد أسابيع؟: Does the effect last after weeks?
dom.هل تفقد المادة فعاليتها عند تعرض الطوب ل: Does the material lose its effectiveness when the brick is exposed to rain?
dom.هل تؤثر المادة على النباتات والتربة والك: Does the material affect plants, soil, and beneficial organisms?
dom.قارن بين مادة طاردة مضافة مباشرة ومادة م: Compare a repellent added directly with an encapsulated one, and see how emission changes over time and with temperature.
dom.محاكاة توضيحية بقيم مفترضة لجدار مساحته: An illustrative simulation with assumed values for a 1 m² wall with a 10 mm surface layer, in a courtyard sheltered from wind. Rain, neem, and lemon are not included in the model and will be measured in the four experiments. The dashed line in the chart is the lowest emission that gives a range of about half a meter.
dom.لا نعد بنتيجة قبل الاختبار. المحاكاة أعل: We promise no result before testing. The simulation above illustrates the encapsulation idea with assumed values, and we do not claim protection from diseases or from the insects that carry them.

dom.سطح أكثر ليونة وأمانًا في مسارات الحدائق: A softer, safer surface for garden paths and children's play areas.
dom.يمتص CO₂ من الهواء للمساهمة في تقليل الا: Absorbs CO₂ from the air to help reduce global warming.
dom.يسمح بتسرّب مياه الأمطار والري إلى الترب: Lets rain and irrigation water seep into the soil instead of running across the surface.
dom.أربع محاكاة توضح فكرة المنتج. هي شرح لتص: Four simulations that explain the product idea. They illustrate our design and are not measurement results; any real number will be published only after testing.
dom.يدخل الماء من الفواصل والمسام، ثم يعبر ط: Water enters through the joints and pores, then passes through the gravel layer into the soil instead of running across the surface.
dom.محاكاة توضيحية لفكرة التصميم. نفاذية الم: An illustrative simulation of the design idea. Actual water permeability will be measured in the lab.
dom.الكربنة المعدنية: كيف يمتص البلاط ثاني أ: Mineral carbonation: how the tile absorbs carbon dioxide and converts it into stable carbonates inside the concrete, helping reduce global warming.
dom.الدائرة الرمادية: CO₂. النقطة الزرقاء: ك: Gray circle: CO₂. Blue dot: calcium. White square: stable carbonate. We are researching this technology globally and testing whether it can be applied to our tile, and we will not state the amount of carbon fixed before measuring it.
dom.طبقة مرنة أسفل البلاط (مثل المطاط المعاد: A flexible layer under the tile (such as recycled rubber) to improve walking comfort.
dom.امتصاص الصدمة عند سقوط وزن: Shock absorption when a weight drops

dom.الرسم يشرح الفكرة فقط. ملاءمة الطبقة ومت: The drawing explains the idea only. The layer's suitability and durability will be determined by these tests.
dom.قارن حرارة بلاط مدماك بالبلاط التقليدي ت: Compare the temperature of the Midmak tile with conventional tile under the same sun.
dom.الفرق الظاهر في الرسم هو ما نتوقعه من ال: The difference shown in the drawing is what we expect from the design (a lighter color, plants and gravel in the openings, pores that evaporate moisture), not a measurement result. js.أطنان من الطوب والخرسانة تُلقى بعد الهدم: Tons of brick and concrete are dumped after demolition, taking up land and wasting material that is still usable.
js.تُفرز المخلفات من موقع الهدم، وتُجمع قطع: Waste is sorted at the demolition site, and the brick pieces are gathered in one place.
js.تُطحن القطع إلى ركام ناعم، ثم تُخلط بنسب: The pieces are ground into fine aggregate, then mixed in measured ratios and shaped in new molds.
js.يعود الطوب طابوقًا وإنترلوك لمسارات الحد: The brick returns as blocks and interlocking pavers for garden paths and decoration: beautiful, eco-friendly, absorbing shocks, water, and carbon dioxide to help reduce global warming.
js.غاز ينتج عن الصناعة والنقل، وهو ما نريد: A gas produced by industry and transport, which we want to reduce.
js.الخرسانة المعاد تدويرها مليئة بمسام دقيق: Recycled concrete is full of tiny pores, and the gas seeps into them.
js.داخل المسام هيدروكسيد الكالسيوم من الإسم: Inside the pores is calcium hydroxide from the old cement, which reacts with the gas in the presence of moisture.
js.ينتج كربونات الكالسيوم، وهي بلورات صلبة: Calcium carbonate is produced: solid crystals that fill the pores and trap carbon inside the material instead of leaving it in the air to add to global warming.
